name: iPhone 17 Pro Max

bottom.datum: no 0.00 datum box is drawn on this bottom view; ordinates run left to right and mirror about the centre, so 0.00 is taken to be the left edge of the view as on the other sheets; view drawn with display up (camera bump at the bottom of the view)

notes: NO TEXT LAYER: on this PDF the main dimensioned sheet (page index 1) has all lettering converted to vector outlines, so pg.get_text('words') returns only the footer and the guide's verbatim text check CANNOT be applied to it. Every value was read visually from crops at 3x to 7x zoom and cross-checked where possible by arithmetic (the seven mirrored pairs of bottom ordinates sum to 77.97 or 77.98 against the 77.98 width; centreLine 4.375 is half of thickness 8.75). CAMERA PLATEAU EDGES ARE NOT DIMENSIONED anywhere in this PDF: DETAIL D shows the full-width bar but gives only the lens, flash, mic and rear-sensor positions, so x0/x1/y0/y1 are null. The drawing writes camera y values as negatives (-14.37 -23.99 -33.61 -13.82 -34.16); reported positive per the guide's y-down convention. '2X 14.37' is the x of cameras 1 and 2; '3X 64.16' is the shared x of flash, rear mic and rear sensor; all three sit on the plateau. BUMP IS NULL ON PURPOSE: the sheet gives 2.55 'BACK PLATE TO CAMERA PLATEAU' and 1.88 'CAMERA PLATEAU TO REAR CAMERA GLASS'; a back-to-camera-glass total is not dimensioned. Camera Control width reads 3.13 on this sheet (3.03 on the 17 Pro): checked at 7x zoom. '4X 4.375' on the left view covers three buttons and SIM tray, '2X 4.375' on the right covers side button and Camera Control. Camera Control is flush (0.00 proud); other buttons 0.45 proud. Bottom ordinates: 15.41 17.65 19.91 22.16 24.42 26.67 32.06 45.91 51.30 53.56 55.81 58.07 60.32 62.57 (32.06 and 45.91 are the two screws; the USB-C opening ends are not given as ordinates). connectorWidth 9.00 is the dimension drawn across the USB-C opening in DETAIL C (unlabelled; my reading of what it spans).
